metadata.name: house
metadata.description: ACME house: the treasury split, the prize vault and the upgrade shop

accounts.name: mint
docs: Absent when `mint_key` is NATIVE_SOL.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Burns the price from their own account; receives the lot (SOL: here).

accounts.name: token_totals
docs: The project token's running totals (what was burned).

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The project token's mint: the burn takes its supply down.

accounts.name: buyer_tokens
docs: The buyer's account of the project token, burned from.

accounts.name: lot_mint
docs: Token lots: the lot's mint, the vault's account of it, the buyer's
(owned by the buyer) and their token program.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the upgrades account's rent on a first purchase (the race server's
sponsor, or the owner).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Pays the cup's rent.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Only the upgrade authority may bootstrap the house.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The project token's mint itself.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin alone: levels are never refunded, so a price only the admin can
set is a price a leaked server key can't drop to nothing.

accounts.name: auction
docs: Made with the admin's lowest rate (`set_auction_floor`): none, no auction.

accounts.name: buyback_tokens
docs: Token lots: the buyback vault's account of `lot_mint`.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Token sweeps: the mint (writable: the project token's share is burned) and
the four parties' token accounts of it (the buyback's only when it gets a
share that isn't burned).

types.name: Auction
docs: The buyback auction of one token (or SOL): the buyback vault's balance sold,
a lot at a time, for the project token, which the buyer burns from their own
wallet. The price, in the project token, for the whole lot, falls evenly
from `start_price` at `start_at` to `floor_price` over `decline_secs` and
holds there until `end_at`. No oracle: the falling price finds the market.
PDA `["auction", lot_mint]` (`NATIVE_SOL` for SOL).

fields.name: lot
docs: For sale now (0: nothing; an auction past `end_at` is over too).

fields.name: min_lot
docs: The admin's lowest rate: no floor prices the lot below `min_price` of
the project token per `min_lot` of it (`set_auction_floor`).

fields.name: last_lot
docs: The last sale's lot, price and time: for `ANCHOR_SECS` after it, a new
floor is held to at least `FLOOR_ANCHOR_BPS` of its rate.

fields.name: sold
docs: Running totals: lots sold, what they paid out, the project token burned.

fields.name: featured_mint
docs: The event's featured stock (`Pubkey::default()` = none).

fields.name: host_share_bps
docs: Community cups only: the host's share of the house fee.

types.name: HouseConfig
docs: The house's settings. PDA `["house"]`.

fields.name: keeper
docs: May fund weekly cups (within the caps).

fields.name: ops_wallet
docs: Where the studio's share goes (its token accounts for SPL).

fields.name: pending_split
docs: A new split takes effect only after `split_after` (a public timelock).

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The project token, set ONCE (`Pubkey::default()` = none yet): its share of
fees is burned, and the buyback share of other tokens builds up for it.

fields.name: fund_max_bps
docs: A funded cup's guarantee may take at most this share of the prize vault's
balance in that token, and at most once per `fund_every_secs`.

fields.name: pending_fund_max_bps
docs: Looser caps, in force from `fund_caps_after` (the split's timelock; 0 =
nothing pending). Tighter ones apply at once.

fields.name: last_fund_at
docs: When a cup was last funded (`i64::MIN`: never).

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops sales and cup funding. Never stops sweeping or anything that pays out.

fields.name: price
docs: The project token the buyer burned.

types.name: PendingToken
docs: The project token, proposed and waiting out `TOKEN_TIMELOCK_SECS` before
anyone applies it to the house. PDA `["token"]`.

types.name: PriceTable
docs: Upgrade prices in one token: department × level 1-5, in base units
(0 = not for sale). PDA `["price", mint]`; SOL is `mint = NATIVE_SOL`.

types.name: Split
docs: How every fee and sale is split by `sweep`, in bps of 10000.

fields.name: ops_bps
docs: The studio's running costs: servers, the audit, development.

fields.name: prize_bps
docs: The prize vault: the weekly stock prizes and other funded cups.

fields.name: buyback_bps
docs: The project token's buyback (burned); until the token exists, prizes.

fields.name: burned
docs: The project token's buyback share, burned instead of kept.

types.name: Totals
docs: Running totals per token, for anyone to read (the project page shows them).
PDA `["totals", mint]`.

types.name: Upgrades
docs: A player's upgrade levels: one account per wallet, for every car look.
PDA `["upgrades", owner]`. A fixed layout the arena program reads raw (the
levels snapshot of a GARAGE room): discriminator (8) | version (1) |
owner (32) | levels [u8; 8] (6 used, `src/game/upgrades.js` order: pu, aero,
tyre, brake, chassis, dur) | updated_at | bump. Never a token: levels can't
be sold or moved.
